title: AndroidAPS doesn't take BG value in main window
body:
AndroidAPS 3.0-rc1
Build version: 86ec769f6
Phone: Poco F3
BG Source: xDrip+ (build 73ada42)
Time: 18:37

It is not the first time that I have seen such behavior. I have to see is there some rule for this to appear. In the screenshots, you can see that the BG value in the home window or tab is crossed while at the same time xDrip+ tab and xDrip+ app show the current BG reading. A log file is attached. Please note that the first screenshot was taken a few minutes later when already a new reading came from xDrip+ but the reading was already at about 18:40 just before I made screenshot of xDrip+.

We have an issue which is probably related (will enable logging when I get my hands on my GF's phone again, since she is the user of AAPS ).  It looks like it sort of started either after the upgrade to AAPS 3.x, or a recent Android security update from Samsung (A52-5g). 

Sensor: Libre 2, either with native Xdrip BT connection (and OOP2) or with Miaomiao2 (tomato) transmitter. 

ALL permissions for AAPS, OOP2 and Xdrip are enabled and Xdrip's inter-app communication settings point toward AAPS. Also, the apps are exempted from any battery optimization. 

Aside from the ever permanently  present yellow triangle (due to the irregular nature of Libre readings), AAPS, at random moments, starts screaming no BG data was received for some long (extended) period of time, sometimes more than one hour. That message is totally incorrect, as AAPS has a complete BG graph and, before the error/alarm popped up, definitely had actual (recent) value.

Looks the same as #2004 so fixed by https://github.com/nightscout/AndroidAPS/commit/8fb5c5a984a8e16062e70282ce3d0fd6383ed864
